items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.title_zh: 笔记本上的 Qwen 3.8 27B 也能解读模型原始权重
items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B on a Laptop Can Interpret Raw Model Weights
items.summary: Simon Willison reports that Qwen 3.8 27B running locally can both interpret and meaningfully discuss raw neural network weights, replicating an example from the 'Sparks of Weight-Space Programming' paper, prompting skeptical and technical discussion about whether such interpretations are actually correct.

items.title: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
items.title_zh: Postman 被指静默安装 AI 插件，并将 API 密钥数据回传服务器
items.title_en: Postman accused of silently installing AI plugins and sending API secrets to its servers
items.summary: A GitHub issue alleges Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and transmits API request data—including secrets—to its servers, sparking a large HN discussion about privacy, HIPAA non-compliance, and developers migrating to Bruno.

items.title: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere) - YouTube
items.title_zh: 视频中微弱的飞机噪音可精确泄露拍摄地点
items.title_en: Faint Aircraft Noise in Videos Can Reveal Exact Recording Locations
items.summary: A demonstration showing how faint background aircraft noise in videos can be analyzed via Doppler curves and cross-referenced with ADS-B data to pinpoint the recording location.
